name: Elder Dinosaurs
description: The greatest of the dinosaurs, ancient and untamable, whose tale took Huatli two years to memorize.

description_citations.text: "Elder". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Through the Sun, Huatli senses the Elder Dinosaurs awaken and calls them to her.
timeline.quote: She called Elder Dinosaurs to her, and felt the ground tremble as they began to approach.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

relations.note: Lets its wielders command the Elder Dinosaurs.
relations.quote: the power of the Immortal Sun gives the Sun Empire warriors who wield it the ability to bring these elder dinosaurs under their command

citation.text: "Dinosaur", section "Elder Dinosaurs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Five ancient, untamable great dinosaurs that awaken with Orazca and answer Huatli's call.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

pages_say.description: Ancient, wild gray-scaled, gold-feathered dinosaurs preserved in Orazca that can be commanded through the Immortal Sun.
